# truenas_ssh_config (Data Source)

Reads the current `ssh` settings. Secrets are not exposed.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `bindiface` (List of String) Array of network interface names to bind the SSH service to.
- `compression` (Boolean) Whether compression is enabled for SSH connections.
- `host_dsa_key_cert_pub` (String) DSA host certificate public key. `null` if not configured.
- `host_dsa_key_pub` (String) DSA host public key. `null` if not configured.
- `host_ecdsa_key_cert_pub` (String) ECDSA host certificate public key. `null` if not configured.
- `host_ecdsa_key_pub` (String) ECDSA host public key. `null` if not configured.
- `host_ed25519_key_cert_pub` (String) Ed25519 host certificate public key. `null` if not configured.
- `host_ed25519_key_pub` (String) Ed25519 host public key. `null` if not configured.
- `host_key_pub` (String) Legacy SSH host public key. `null` if not configured.
- `host_rsa_key_cert_pub` (String) RSA host certificate public key. `null` if not configured.
- `host_rsa_key_pub` (String) RSA host public key. `null` if not configured.
- `id` (Number) Identifier assigned by TrueNAS.
- `kerberosauth` (Boolean) Whether Kerberos authentication is enabled.
- `options` (String) Additional SSH daemon configuration options.
- `password_login_groups` (List of String) Array of group names allowed to authenticate with passwords.
- `passwordauth` (Boolean) Whether password authentication is enabled.
- `sftp_log_facility` (String) Syslog facility for SFTP logging (empty string means default).
- `sftp_log_level` (String) Logging level for SFTP subsystem (empty string means default).
- `tcpfwd` (Boolean) Whether TCP forwarding is enabled.
- `tcpport` (Number) TCP port number for SSH connections.
- `weak_ciphers` (List of String) Array of weak ciphers to enable for compatibility with legacy clients.
